verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm a live llms.txt at docs.adyen.com that explicitly covers point-of-sale, and markdown versions of docs pages such as point-of-sale.md, which are directly consumable by agents. Many POS doc citations also resolve to .md URLs, so the agent-readable format extends across the in-person payments docs. Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing or maintaining these agent-oriented docs (for example an llms-full.txt or a usage guide), and independent or community corroboration of agents using them successfully.
